# smtpfast_inbox_label (Resource)

A named, colored label in an inbox, for tagging its threads. An inbox can have up to 100 labels.

Deleting the label takes it off every thread that carries it; no message is removed. Deleting the inbox deletes its labels.

Needs a provider API key with the `inbound:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smtpfast_inbox" "support" {
  email_address = "support@inbound.example.com"
}

resource "smtpfast_inbox_label" "urgent" {
  inbox_id = smtpfast_inbox.support.id
  name     = "Urgent"
  color    = "crimson"
}

resource "smtpfast_inbox_label" "billing" {
  inbox_id = smtpfast_inbox.support.id
  name     = "Billing"
  # color is mauve when omitted
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inbox_id` (String) ID of the inbox, such as `smtpfast_inbox.support.id`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the label, up to 64 characters, unique in the inbox ignoring case. Updates in place.

### Optional

- `color` (String) One of `cyan`, `teal`, `grass`, `lime`, `yellow`, `orange`, `iris`, `plum`, `crimson`, `bronze`, `mauve`. `mauve` on create when omitted. When omitted later, Terraform keeps the current color, so a color picked in the dashboard stays.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the label.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the inbox id and the label id, separated by a slash.
terraform import smtpfast_inbox_label.urgent inb_abc123/lbl_xyz789
```
